**`tests/test_limiter.py`** — 14 tests covering each spec rule: key mapping, refill/cap/empty behaviour, ceil rounding (41 ms on an empty standard bucket), 37-request standard burst, 74-request gold burst (21 ms retry), gold refilling the full burst within the same 1500 ms window, per-key isolation, header/body contents, and the rejection log record.

Untouched: `limiter/__init__.py`, `vendor/`. The September draft's numbers (30/1000 ms, `RATE_LIMITED`, `Retry-After`) were deliberately ignored — the spec supersedes it.

One judgement call worth flagging: "gold gets 2× the burst (the refill time stays 1500 ms)" is read as *doubled burst over the same full-refill window*, so gold also refills twice as fast. The alternative (same per-token interval, 3000 ms full refill) contradicts the parenthetical; `test_gold_tier_refills_the_whole_burst_within_the_same_window` pins the choice. Changes are uncommitted.
